description: BPSC TRE Computer Science Model Test Paper 02 (English Medium) containing 120 questions across General Studies and Computer Science.

questions.questionText: The cost of 5 bats and 18 balls is 6,500 and the cost of 2 bats and 20 balls is 4,200. What are the costs of one bat and one ball respectively?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 5x + 18y = 6500 aur 2x + 20y = 4200 ko solve karne par x = 850 aur y = 125 milta hai.

questions.questionText: A shopkeeper purchases an item at 615 and sells it at 820. What is his percentage profit?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: A hacker finds that the ATM PIN of a person has first two digits ranging from 3 to 8, and the fourth digit is either 0 or 9. How many attempts must the hacker try in order to decode the PIN?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: First digit ke 6 choices (3-8), second ke 6 choices, third digit ke 10 choices (0-9), aur fourth ke 2 choices (0 ya 9). Total attempts = 6 * 6 * 10 * 2 = 720.

questions.questionText: The lengths of two sides of a triangle are 8 cm and 9 cm, and its area is 12*sqrt(5) cm2. What is the length of the third side?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Area = (1/2)*a*b*sin(C) => 12*sqrt(5) = (1/2)*8*9*sin(C) => sin(C) = sqrt(5)/3. Isse cos(C) = 2/3 ya -2/3 ho sakta hai. Law of cosines se c = 7 cm ya c = sqrt(145) cm (yaani do sambhav man), isliye More than one of the above sahi hai.

questions.questionText: There are 50 numbers. Each number is subtracted from 53, and the mean of the numbers so obtained is found to be -3.5. The mean of the given numbers is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: The ratio of the ages of two brothers is 4:3. If the elder brother is 6 years older than the younger one, then their ages (in years) are
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 4x - 3x = x = 6. Unki aayu kramashah 4*6 = 24 varsh aur 3*6 = 18 varsh hogi.

questions.questionText: The quadratic equation with roots 1 and 4 is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Roots 1 aur 4 ke liye equation hoti hai x^2 - (1 + 4)x + (1 * 4) = x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0, jo options me nahi hai.

questions.questionText: An article is marked at 20% above the cost price. If a discount of 10% is allowed on the marked price, what is the profit percentage?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: CP = 100 maanein, toh MP = 120. SP = 120 ka 90% = 108. Profit = 8%.

questions.questionText: By what smallest number should 128 be multiplied to obtain a perfect square?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 128 = 2^7. Perfect square banane ke liye 2 se multiply karne par 2^8 = 256 banega, jo 16 ka square hai.

questions.questionText: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 years. Six years ago, father's age was five times the age of the son. After 6 years, what will be the son's age?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: F + S = 60. 6 saal pehle: (F - 6) = 5(S - 6) => F - 5S = -24. Solve karne par S = 14 varsh. 6 varsh baad son ki age 14 + 6 = 20 varsh hogi.

questions.questionText: An electric heater of resistance 8 ohm draws 15A current from a service mains for 2 hours. What will be the rate at which heat is developed in the heater?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rate of heat development (Power) = I^2 * R = 15^2 * 8 = 225 * 8 = 1800 W, jo diye gaye options me nahi hai.

questions.questionText: The focal length of a convex lens is f = 10 cm. On immersing in water, it will act as a
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pani me lens ka relative refractive index kam hone ke kaaran focal length badh jati hai, par lens convex hi rehta hai.

questions.questionText: The speed of an electron in the orbit of the hydrogen atom in the ground state is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bohr model me ground state electron ki speed v = c * alpha hoti hai, jahan fine structure constant alpha lagbhag 1/137 hota hai.

questions.questionText: A blackbody radiates energy at the rate of E watt per metre^2 at a high temperature T K. When the temperature is reduced to T/3 K, the radiant energy will be
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Stefan-Boltzmann law ke anusaar E proportional to T^4 hota hai. Temperature T/3 hone par energy (1/3)^4 * E = E/81 ho jayegi.

questions.questionText: Ginger is an underground stem and not a root because
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Nodes aur internodes stem ke definitive features hote hain, jo adrak me paye jaate hain.

questions.questionText: Which of the following lenses would you prefer to use while reading small letters found in a dictionary?
questions.optionA: A convex lens of 50 cm focal length
questions.optionB: A concave lens of 50 cm focal length
questions.optionC: A concave lens of 5 cm focal length
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Chhote aksharon ko magnification ke sath padhne ke liye kam focal length (jaise 5 cm) wale convex lens ki zaroorat hoti hai, jo option me nahi hai.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a part of the female reproductive system in human beings?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Vas deferens male reproductive system ka hissa hota hai.

questions.questionText: Asexual reproduction takes place through budding in
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Yeast aur Hydra me asexual reproduction budding (mukulon) dwara hota hai.

questions.questionText: Which of the following types of medicines is used for treating indigestion?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pet ki acidity aur indigestion ko neutralize karne ke liye Antacids ka upyog hota hai.

questions.questionText: The acid which can destroy the color of acidic KMnO4 solution is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Citric acid (C6H8O7) KMnO4 ke pink color ko decolorize kar deta hai.

questions.questionText: The Sun observation point of the Aditya-L1 satellite is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Aditya-L1 ko Sun-Earth system ke Lagrange point 1 (L1) par sthapit kiya gaya hai.

questions.questionText: What is the name of the spacecraft launched by ISRO to carry Indian astronauts into space?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: ISRO ke human spaceflight mission ka naam Gaganyaan hai.

questions.questionText: Who was the architect of the new Parliament of India building inaugurated in New Delhi?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: New Delhi me bane naye sansad bhavan ke chief architect Bimal Patel hain.

questions.questionText: In which country did India first launch its unified payment interface (UPI) in the African region?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: India ne African region me sabse pehle Mauritius me UPI aur RuPay services launch kiye.

questions.questionText: When is the Human Rights Day celebrated globally each year?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: UN Universal Declaration of Human Rights ki yaad me har saal 10 December ko Human Rights Day manaya jata hai.

questions.questionText: Which country is not a member of the G7 intergovernmental forum?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Russia ko 2014 me G8 se nikal diya gaya tha, isliye ab woh G7 ka sadasya nahi hai.

questions.questionText: Who was the author of the song 'Banglar Mati, Banglar Jal', adopted as the State Anthem of West Bengal?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Is patriotic geet ki rachna Rabindranath Tagore ne 1905 Bengal partition ke virodh me ki thi.

questions.questionText: The founder of the Indian National Army (INA) in Southeast Asia was
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: INA ki sthapna sabse pehle Captain Mohan Singh ne Japanese sena ki madad se 1942 me ki thi.

questions.questionText: The Tana Bhagat Movement in the Chotanagpur region was primarily related to
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Tana Bhagat aandolan Jatra Bhagat ke netritva me shuru hua ek prasiddha tribal (aadivasi) aandolan tha.

questions.questionText: In which Indian state is Raksha Bandhan celebrated as 'Vriksh Suraksha Divas' (Tree Safety Day)?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bihar sarkar dwara paryavaran sanrakshan ko badhava dene ke liye Raksha Bandhan ko Vriksh Suraksha Divas ke roop me manaya jata hai.

questions.questionText: Minerals are deposited and accumulated in the horizontal strata of which class of rocks?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sedimentary rocks me nakshepa aur paraton (strata) ke jamaav ke roop me koyla aur petroleum jaise khanij paye jaate hain.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a leguminous pulse crop that fixes atmospheric nitrogen?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Daalein (pulses) leguminous fasal hoti hain jinki jado me Rhizobium bacteria atmospheric nitrogen fix karte hain.

questions.questionText: Which two extreme locations of India are connected by the East-West Corridor of the Golden Quadrilateral project?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: East-West Corridor Silchar (Assam) ko Porbandar (Gujarat) se jodta hai.

questions.questionText: Stalactite and stalagmite depositional landforms in karst topography are formed by
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Chuna-patthar gufaon me underground water ke chemical precipitation se stalactite aur stalagmite bante hain.

questions.questionText: The highest mountain peak in the Eastern Ghats of India is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Diye gaye vikalpon me Mahendragiri Eastern Ghats ki pramukh choti hai.

questions.questionText: In which district of Bihar is the production of silk textiles maximum?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bhagalpur ko 'Silk City of Bihar' kaha jata hai kyonki yahan Tussar silk ka utpadan sabse zyada hota hai.

questions.questionText: Who described the Revolt of 1857 as the 'First Indian War of Independence'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Vinayak Damodar Savarkar ne apni pustak me 1857 ke vidroh ko Bharat ka pratham swatantrata sangram kaha tha .

questions.questionText: Which of the following peasant movements or rebellions occurred earliest chronologically?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Santhal vidroh 1855-56 me hua, jabki Birsa Munda vidroh 1899-1900 aur Tana Bhagat 1914 me huye .

questions.questionText: Who presided over the Gaya Session of the Indian National Congress held in 1922?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 1922 ke Gaya Congress adhiveshan ki adhyakshata Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das ne ki thi .

questions.questionText: Who founded the Hindu College at Calcutta in 1817 along with Raja Ram Mohan Roy?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: David Hare ne Raja Ram Mohan Roy aur Radhakanta Deb ke sath milkar 1817 me Hindu College sthapit kiya tha .

questions.questionText: Which unit is considered the fundamental operational brain of any computer system?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: CPU sabhi computational instructions ko execute karta hai, isliye ise computer ka brain kaha jata hai .

questions.questionText: When a key is pressed on a standard keyboard, which encoding standard is traditionally used to convert the keystroke into bit representation?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: ASCII (American Standard Code for Information Interchange) standard keys ko binary bits me convert karta hai .

questions.questionText: Which underlying technological advancement distinguishes fifth-generation computing systems from previous generations?
questions.optionA: Artificial Intelligence and Ultra Large Scale Integration (ULSI)
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 5th generation computers me ULSI microprocessor aur Artificial Intelligence ki capabilities shamil hain.

questions.questionText: Software whose source code is openly available for inspection, modification, and redistribution is termed as:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Open source software ka code publically view, modify aur redistribute karne ke liye uplabdh hota hai .

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an inherent characteristic of machine language?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Machine language sidhe hardware instructions par chalti hai, isliye yeh platform/machine dependent hoti hai .

questions.questionText: Assembly language is formally categorized as:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Assembly language mnemonics ka upyog karti hai aur processor architecture ke bohot kareeb hoti hai, isliye yeh low-level hai .

questions.questionText: What does a language compiler do during software translation?
questions.optionA: Translates the entire source code into machine/object code at once
questions.optionB: Interprets code line by line at runtime
questions.optionC: Executes assembly mnemonics directly without generating object code
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Compiler pure high-level source code ko ek saath scan karke executable/object code banata hai .

questions.questionText: Which software engineering paradigm and design approach is primarily followed by object-oriented C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Object-oriented languages pehle low-level classes aur objects design karti hain, isliye yeh bottom-up approach hai .

questions.questionText: What is the fundamental purpose of virtual base class inheritance in C++?
questions.optionA: To increase the compile-time execution overhead
questions.optionB: To prevent multiple duplicate copies of a common base class in multiple inheritance (diamond problem)
questions.optionC: To convert private variables into public scope automatically
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Virtual base class multiple inheritance me common ancestor class ki duplicate copies (diamond problem) ko rokti hai .

questions.questionText: What will happen if the statement 'int *ptr = NULL; delete ptr;' is compiled and executed in C++?
questions.optionA: It generates a compile-time syntax error
questions.optionB: It causes a fatal runtime segmentation fault
questions.optionC: It executes safely without any error
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: C++ standard ke anusaar null pointer par delete call karna completely safe hota hai aur yeh koi operation nahi karta .

questions.questionText: What is the functional difference between the operators 'delete' and 'delete[]' in C++?
questions.optionA: 'delete' deallocates memory for single objects, while 'delete[]' deallocates arrays of objects
questions.optionB: 'delete[]' is illegal in standard modern C++
questions.optionC: 'delete' calls destructors for multiple instances whereas 'delete[]' does not
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'delete' single dynamically allocated object ke liye hota hai aur 'delete[]' dynamically allocated arrays ke destructors ko call karke memory free karta hai .

questions.questionText: What is the behavior when compiling code that declares 'int new = 5;' in standard C versus C++?
questions.optionA: Compiles successfully in both C and C++
questions.optionB: Throws an error in C but compiles fine in C++
questions.optionC: Compiles successfully in C but produces an error in C++ because 'new' is a reserved keyword
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'new' C++ me dynamic memory allocation ka reserved keyword hai, jabki C me yeh keyword nahi hai .

questions.questionText: What will be the output of evaluating expression ((10 | 5) + (true + false)) in C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: The program block designed to enclose statements that might throw runtime exceptions in C++ is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Exception-prone code ko hamesha 'try' block ke andar likha jata hai .

questions.questionText: Which statement is true regarding inline functions in C++?
questions.optionA: They always reduce the final compiled code size
questions.optionB: The compiler substitutes the function code directly at the point of call to eliminate function call overhead
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Compiler function call overhead ko hatane ke liye call site par hi code replace kar deta hai .

questions.questionText: What distinguishes an abstract class in C++ from a regular concrete class?
questions.optionA: It contains at least one pure virtual function (= 0) and cannot be directly instantiated
questions.optionB: It can never be used as a base class
questions.optionC: It cannot contain member variable declarations
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Abstract class me kam se kam ek pure virtual function hota hai aur iska direct object create nahi kiya ja sakta .

questions.questionText: If no constructors are defined explicitly within a class, which constructor is generated implicitly by the C++ compiler?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Compiler bina kisi argument wala default constructor automatically provide karta hai .

questions.questionText: What is the fundamental default difference between a struct and a class in C++?
questions.optionA: Struct members are public by default, while class members are private by default
questions.optionB: Struct cannot contain member functions in C++
questions.optionC: Class cannot be inherited in C++
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: C++ me struct ke members default roop se public hote hain, jabki class ke members default roop se private hote hain .

questions.questionText: A programming language that supports user-defined data types alongside built-in types is referred to as:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Naye data types ko define karne ki suvidha dene wali language ko extensible language kaha jata hai .

questions.questionText: Who was the creator of the C++ programming language at Bell Labs?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bjarne Stroustrup ne 1979 me C with Classes (baad me C++) ko develop kiya tha .

questions.questionText: In C++, which stream method can be used to read a single character from the console?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: cin.get(ch) ya cin.get() whitespace samet single character read karne ke liye prayukt hota hai.

questions.questionText: In zero-indexed arrays, how is the nth element accessed using standard indexing?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Index 0 se shuru hone ke kaaran nth element hamesha array[n - 1] par sthit hota hai .

questions.questionText: What is the variable scope of an identifier declared locally inside a user-defined function block?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Block ke andar ghoshit variable kewal usi curly braces {} ke andar accessible hota hai .

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly describes 'new' and 'malloc' in C++?
questions.optionA: 'new' is an operator that invokes constructors, whereas 'malloc' is a function that does not call constructors
questions.optionB: 'malloc' automatically calculates type sizes without sizeof
questions.optionC: 'new' returns a void pointer that requires explicit casting
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'new' C++ operator hai jo type-safe memory allocate karta hai aur constructor call karta hai, jabki 'malloc' C library function hai jo constructor call nahi karta .

questions.questionText: Which class members can be inherited by a derived class but remain inaccessible directly within the derived class code?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Base class ke private members inherit toh hote hain par derived class unhe directly access nahi kar sakti .

questions.questionText: What happens if a class is declared without an identifier name in C++?
questions.optionA: It is treated as an unnamed (anonymous) class
questions.optionB: It can never possess member methods
questions.optionC: The compiler stops with a mandatory fatal error
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bina naam wali class ko anonymous class kaha jata hai, jiska upyog turant object declaration ke sath kiya ja sakta hai.

questions.questionText: How is compile-time polymorphism achieved in C++?
questions.optionA: Through virtual functions and runtime dispatch
questions.optionB: Through function overloading and operator overloading
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Function overloading aur operator overloading static/compile-time polymorphism pradaan karte hain.

questions.questionText: The software design concept of bundling data attributes and methods that manipulate them into a single unit while restricting direct access is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Data aur methods ko ek sath class unit me bandhna Encapsulation kehlata hai .

questions.questionText: Which data structure follows the Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) order of operations?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Stack hamesha LIFO (Last In First Out) order follow karta hai.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a standard application of the stack data structure?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Asynchronous job scheduling ke liye Queue data structure ka upyog kiya jata hai, Stack ka nahi .

questions.questionText: What is the prefix notation for the mathematical expression A + B * C?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Operator precedence ke hisaab se B*C banta hai *BC, fir A + (*BC) banta hai + A * B C .

questions.questionText: Which data structure is utilized to convert an infix expression into prefix or postfix form?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Operators ke precedence aur associativity ko manage karne ke liye Stack ka upyog hota hai .

questions.questionText: The condition checked to verify if an element can be safely extracted from an empty queue is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Khali queue se delete karne se pehle Underflow condition check hoti hai .

questions.questionText: Which data structure operates on a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) access policy?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Queue me jo element pehle insert hota hai wahi pehle remove hota hai (FIFO) .

questions.questionText: What is an alternate technical term used for a circular queue buffer?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Circular queue ko aamtaur par Ring Buffer bhi kaha jata hai .

questions.questionText: What is the primary operational advantage of implementing a circular queue over a linear array-based queue?
questions.optionA: It executes operations with O(log N) time
questions.optionB: It prevents false overflow and eliminates memory wastage caused by fixed indices
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Circular queue me empty slots par dobara wrap-around karke insert kiya ja sakta hai, jisse memory waste nahi hoti .

questions.questionText: Which data structure provides optimal implementation for a Priority Queue where insertions and extract-max/min take O(log N)?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Binary Heap priority queue ko implement karne ka sabse efficient tree-based structure hai .

questions.questionText: Which of the following data structures is implicitly maintained during recursive procedure execution?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Recursion ke return addresses aur local variables ko system ke call stack me store kiya jata hai .

questions.questionText: In a red-black tree, what is the mandatory color of the root node?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Red-Black tree properties ke mutabik Root node hamesha Black hona chahiye .

questions.questionText: In an array-based implementation of a linear queue of size MAX_SIZE, what is the overflow condition when items are inserted only at rear?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Jab rear index aakhiri slot (MAX_SIZE - 1) par pahunch jata hai toh linear queue me overflow ho jata hai .

questions.questionText: Which sorting algorithm is a classic implementation of the divide-and-conquer paradigm?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Merge sort array ko halves me divide karta hai aur sorted sub-arrays ko merge karta hai .

questions.questionText: In database management systems, what is metadata defined as?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Metadata ka aashay data ke structure, data types aur constraints (data about data) se hota hai .

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a recognized architecture model for database systems?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: RDBMS, Network DBMS aur Distributed DBMS standard models hain, 'Decentralized DBMS' traditional model nahi hai .

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a database management software engine?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: IBM Db2, Microsoft Access aur PostgreSQL teeno DBMS software hain .

questions.questionText: Which feature is not an expected capability of a multi-user enterprise DBMS?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Enterprise DBMS multiple users ke concurrent access ko support karta hai, single-user limit nahi rakhta .

questions.questionText: What is the minimal set of one or more attributes that uniquely identifies a row in a relation called?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Minimal superkey jo records ko uniquely identify kare, use Candidate Key kehte hain.

questions.questionText: Which SQL Data Manipulation command removes all records from table 'STUDENT' without dropping the table definition?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'DELETE FROM table_name;' table schema ko banaye rakhte huye sabhi rows ko delete karta hai .

questions.questionText: What normal form addresses and eliminates transitive functional dependencies in a relational table?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 3NF ensure karta hai ki koi non-prime attribute kisi anya non-prime attribute par dependent na ho (no transitive dependency).

questions.questionText: Storing duplicate copies of identical data in multiple unlinked files leads to:
questions.optionA: Data inconsistency and wastage of storage
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Redundant data update anomalies aur data inconsistency ka sabse bada kaaran banta hai .

questions.questionText: Which SQL data type is suited to store large binary unstructured data such as image or sound files?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: BLOB (Binary Large Object) images, videos aur audio files ko store karne ke liye use hota hai.

questions.questionText: Which digital logic gate outputs HIGH (1) when all its input bits are identical?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: X-NOR gate equivalence gate kehlata hai jo inputs same (0,0 ya 1,1) hone par output 1 deta hai .

questions.questionText: The transmission of data from a keyboard to a computer processor is an example of:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Communication hamesha unidirectional (keyboard se computer) hota hai, isliye yeh Simplex hai .

questions.questionText: What is the simplified equivalent of the Boolean function Y = A + AB?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Absorption law ke anusaar: A + AB = A(1 + B) = A(1) = A.

questions.questionText: How is the dual of a Boolean expression obtained systematically?
questions.optionA: By replacing each AND with OR, each OR with AND, and interchanging 0s and 1s
questions.optionB: By complementing all literal variables only
questions.optionC: By taking the two's complement of each term
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Duality principle me operators (+ aur .) ko aapas me swap kiya jata hai aur identity elements 0 aur 1 ko swap kiya jata hai .

questions.questionText: Unauthorized eavesdropping or packet sniffing on a local network can be reduced by implementing:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Switches unicast frames forward karte hain aur encryption data ko unreadable bana deti hai, jisse sniffing rukti hai .

questions.questionText: In synchronous Time Division Multiplexing (TDM), data streams are interleaved into:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: TDM me time domain ko fixed time slots aur frames me baanta jata hai .

questions.questionText: What mechanism does the Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) use to establish a reliable connection between client and server?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: TCP connection establish karne ke liye SYN -> SYN-ACK -> ACK packet exchange karta hai .

questions.questionText: An endpoint combination of an IP address and a transport port number used for network communication is known as a:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: IP Address aur Port number ka combination network communication endpoint 'Socket' kehlata hai .

questions.questionText: Which physical transmission medium provides the highest data transfer bandwidth and lowest susceptibility to electromagnetic interference?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Optical fiber light pulses ka upyog karta hai, isliye isme EMI nahi hoti aur sabse zyada bandwidth milti hai .

questions.questionText: A set of library routines providing programmable access to draw two-dimensional graphical elements is termed:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Graphics library routines jo primitives draw karne ki functionality de, Graphics Package kehlati hai.

questions.questionText: Which keyboard shortcut compiles and runs a C++ program in Turbo C++ IDE environment?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Turbo C++ me Ctrl + F9 program ko compile aur run dono karta hai.

questions.questionText: Which CPU component issues command and timing signals to coordinate actions of ALU and memory?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Control Unit instructions fetch karke control aur timing signals issue karti hai.

questions.questionText: Which standard extension is widely used for user-defined C++ header files?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Header files ka extension .h ya .hpp hota hai.

questions.questionText: Which CPU addressing mode requires no memory reference to fetch operands because data is embedded directly in the instruction?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Immediate addressing me operand instruction ka hi hissa hota hai, koi memory lookup nahi chahiye.

questions.questionText: Intermediate temporary buffer storage used in devices to compensate for speed disparities between fast processors and slower peripherals is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Buffer registers aur cache speed mismatch ko handle karne ke liye use hote hain.

questions.questionText: In memory-mapped I/O architecture:
questions.optionA: I/O ports and primary memory share a unified address space
questions.optionB: I/O devices use independent address ranges accessible only by IN/OUT instructions
questions.optionC: Direct Memory Access is strictly banned
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Memory-mapped I/O me memory aur I/O ek hi address space share karte hain.

questions.questionText: Which statement correctly declares an array of 10 integers in C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'int arr[10];' standard syntax hai 10 elements ke integer array ko declare karne ka.

questions.questionText: In SQL, virtual tables defined by an underlying stored query are referred to as:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: SQL me Views virtual tables hoti hain jinka data physical disk me nahi balki underlying tables par query ke through banta hai.

questions.questionText: How many Primary Keys can exist within a single relational database table?
questions.optionC: Equal to the number of indexed columns
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Ek table me kewal ek hi Primary Key ho sakti hai (bhale hi woh multiple columns ka composite key ho).

questions.questionText: Which SQL keyword cannot be used as an integrity column constraint?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: UNION ek set operator hai, constraint nahi.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a recognized built-in aggregate function in standard SQL?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: COMPUTE koi aggregate function nahi hai (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX standard hote hain).

questions.questionText: Who is historically credited as the father of modern computing?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Analytical Engine ke aavishkarak Charles Babbage ko father of computer kaha jata hai.

questions.questionText: In relational algebra, which join variant pairs tuples from two tables based on common attributes without duplicate column naming?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Natural join samaan attributes ke base par match karta hai aur duplicate columns ko automatically remove kar deta hai.

questions.questionText: What is the time complexity of pushing an element onto an array-based stack with a top pointer?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Top pointer hone ke kaaran sidhe index par insertion hota hai, jo constant time O(1) leta hai.

questions.questionText: In a doubly linked list, each node contains:
questions.optionA: Data, pointer to next node, and pointer to previous node
questions.optionB: Data and single pointer to head
questions.optionC: Pointer to parent and child nodes
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Doubly linked list ke node me data ke sath agle (next) aur pichhle (prev) dono nodes ke pointers hote hain.

questions.questionText: In a Binary Search Tree (BST), the left child of any node always contains a key that is:
questions.optionA: Less than the parent node key
questions.optionB: Greater than the parent node key
questions.optionC: Equal to the right sibling key
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: BST property ke anusaar: Left Child < Parent < Right Child.

questions.questionText: An expression written as a sum of minterms is known in Boolean algebra as:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Minterms ke sum (ORing) ko Sum of Products (SOP) standard form kaha jata hai.

questions.questionText: Which network hardware device operates at the physical layer of the OSI model and regenerates incoming signals?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Repeater OSI model ke Layer 1 (Physical Layer) par signal strength ko amplify/regenerate karta hai.

questions.questionText: Which command-line diagnostic tool uses ICMP packets to verify IP connectivity across network nodes?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: ping utility ICMP Echo Request aur Reply packets bhej kar network connectivity verify karti hai.

questions.questionText: Which elemental semiconductor crystal serves as the foundational substrate for integrated circuits and microchips?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Silicon semiconductor properties aur prachur matra me uplabdh hone ke kaaran computer chips ka mukhya tatva hai.
